Meta.title: ONEBODY — Meant to be ONE
Meta.description: Global donation platform of the ONEBODY Foundation. We build homes, feed families, and sustain communities in the Dominican Republic. Many members, one body.

Hero.subtitle: Every donation is a point that converges. Together we form something whole: homes, food, education, and hope for real families.

About.title: Meant to be one
About.lead: ONEBODY is a global foundation that turns the generosity of many into a single gesture of change. Every donation brings one person closer to another.
About.missionTitle: So no one is left out
About.missionBody: We believe helping shouldn't be complicated. We connect those who want to give with real, verified projects —housing, food, education, health— and show, with open data, where every contribution goes.
About.value1b: Behind every number there is a person. We treat every donation with the care of a human encounter.
About.value2b: Every contribution is traceable. We publish budgets, updates and receipts: trust is proven, not asked for.
About.value3b: Four points converging into one. Alone we do little; together, we change lives.
About.whereEyebrow: From the Dominican Republic to the world
About.whereBody: We were born in Santiago de los Caballeros and work in 15 languages so generosity knows no borders.

Impact.title: Change, in real numbers
Impact.lead: This isn't a promise: it's already happening. Live figures of what we've achieved together.
Impact.ctaTitle: Your gift is the next number
Impact.ctaBody: Every donation moves these figures up. Join today.

Transparency.title: Nothing to hide
Transparency.lead: Trust is our currency. See how we care for every donation, from start to finish.
Transparency.pillar1b: Every donation is recorded and tied to a project. You can follow its path.
Transparency.pillar2b: For every contribution we generate a downloadable PDF receipt. No exceptions.
Transparency.pillar3b: Our audit log cannot be altered or deleted: not even by us.
Transparency.flow1: You donate securely: we ask for the minimum and never store your card details.
Transparency.flow2: Your contribution is assigned to a real project with a public budget.
Transparency.flow3: The team delivers and publishes updates with photos and figures.
Transparency.flow4: You see it all: receipt, project progress and its goal met.
Transparency.q1: How much of my donation reaches the project?
Transparency.a1: We work so most of it goes straight through. Each project shows its budget so you see the breakdown.
Transparency.a2: Yes. Payments are processed by certified providers and we never store your card details.
Transparency.a3: Of course. You can hide your name from the public wall; the accounting record is kept, as the law requires.
